name: Yuuki Asuka
source: Hikaru's mother, who is actually one of the executives of Nemesis and a fallen magical girl. She follows orders from her boss to corrupt Hikaru and George through various schemes. Appears younger after transforming into a magical girl, allowing her to hide her true identity from them. Has a voluptuous, mature body and exudes a warm, gentle demeanor as a mother. While she wants Hikaru to live a normal life as a girl, she has no hesitation in corrupting her due to the boss's orders. Holds a grudge against George for involving Hikaru.
